post_C3_log_distance_quartiles.definition: For every analysed P1S pair, compute absolute promoter-distal midpoint distance in hg38 after C3. Stratify analysed pairs by quartiles of log(distance_bp), using the full analysed-pair population to define the three cutpoints.

promoter_degree_quartiles.definition: For every analysed P1S pair, define promoter degree as the number of analysed P1S edges assigned to the same source-oriented promoter anchor. Assign the same degree to all edges from that promoter and stratify analysed pairs by quartiles of this degree using the full analysed-pair population.

local_density_status.original_contract_text: For each observed/null distal interval and each ATAC track, count peak midpoints within +/-50 kb of the interval midpoint; report E_c and D contrasts by pooled quartiles of local peak density.
local_density_status.under_specification: The contract does not define a unique mapping from six per-pair density measurements (observed/null x three tracks) to one common pooled-quartile stratum.
local_density_status.already_exposed_result: Claude reported quartiles defined from microglia observed-distal density only; this is informative but is not the frozen pooled-density sensitivity.
local_density_status.rule_now: Do not select one pooling operator post-exposure and call it prospectively frozen.
local_density_status.acceptable_followup: If local-density sensitivity is completed, label it outcome-exposed and report a transparent multi-definition panel rather than selecting one favorable stratification. None may alter P1S PASS.

required_output_status.P1S_contract_reporting: COMPLETE only after log-distance and promoter-degree reports are added; local-density remains an explicitly exposed sensitivity limitation unless a multi-definition descriptive successor is executed.
required_output_status.low_density_claim: Current microglia-only density Q1 warning is provisional/non-authoritative for the frozen pooled-density sensitivity, but must remain visible as a possible limitation.
